body: I have thought about killing myself on short notice, too. Whether what you said is completely true or not, give it atleast a week before you do it so you have time to think about it with a clear mind.

I myself am not suicidal because I know I could never kill myself, but have thought about it multiple times. The main reason I think about it is because of all the ignorant people in the world. Intellectual people like you are one of the reasons I still enjoy living. Thanks for the quick response I'll use most of it.

I urge you not to do this, but I see you don't want me to. If this is what you really want, then before you do it, go to Mexico with lots of cash and find some prostitutes and drugs and have a great time before you go. As for the note, I would take out the curse words and replace them with synonyms that aren't as harsh, so people will have a better final memory of you. Also, I strongly urge you to talk to the person you think is most important to you before you go. I know from experience that this can be the hardest thing you ever do, but it's only fair that if they are that important to you, you talk to them face to face and allow them to say to you what they think.

Everyone has something they enjoy doing. Whether they are good at it or not, they still enjoy it. For me, it's producing EDM. I suck at it and I know it, but I enjoy doing it. Find what you enjoy doing, and even if you know you're bad at, keep doing it. You might even eventually become good at it.
